       ROUND(CAST(AVG(w.waterqualityindex) AS numeric), 2) as avg_water_quality_index,
       ROUND(CAST(AVG(waterlevelpercent * CAST(waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100 * (1 - wastetanklevelpercent / 100)) AS numeric), 2) as avg_wrmi_score,
       SUM(CASE WHEN waterlevelpercent * CAST(waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100 * (1 - wastetanklevelpercent / 100) < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_systems_need_water_saving,
       CASE 
           WHEN AVG(w.waterqualityindex) >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality'
           WHEN AVG(waterqualityindex) >= 71 AND AVG(waterqualityindex) < 91 THEN 'Good'
           WHEN AVG(waterqualityindex) >= 51 AND AVG(waterqualityindex) < 71 THEN 'Moderate'
           WHEN AVG(waterqualityindex) >= 26 AND AVG(waterqualityindex) < 51 THEN 'Poor'
           ELSE 'Unsafe'
       END as classification,
       CASE 
           WHEN AVG(waterlevelpercent * CAST(waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100 * (1 - wastetanklevelpercent / 100)) < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed'
           WHEN AVG(waterlevelpercent * CAST(waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100 * (1 - wastetanklevelpercent / 100)) >= 0.5 AND AVG(waterlevelpercent * CAST(waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100 * (1 - wastetanklevelpercent / 100)) < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised'
           ELSE 'Sustainable Management'
       END as management_situation
FROM waterandwaste w
JOIN location l ON w.watereqref = l.loceqref
GROUP BY l.stationname, l.locationtype
ORDER BY l.stationname, l.locationtype;
